note: Section 10 view, extracted from quality_summary.json's layout_comparison_section10 for a dedicated artifact.
definition: at the SAME q8_count=8 / SAME KV-byte budget / SAME residency, does profile-sensitivity placement beat naive placements on mean logit_rel_l2 (measured against the same true F16 reference)?
finding: Yes -- profile-sensitivity placement still beats every naive equal-budget layout on mean logit_rel_l2 in the forced-Q5 constrained regime (consistent with Phase 11C/11D's finding in the comfortable-memory regime). But ALL mixed layouts, sensitivity-based or naive, are worse than whole-cache Q5 on this metric at PRIMARY POINT B -- sensitivity placement is the best mixed strategy, but 'best mixed' is still not competitive with the simpler whole-cache-Q5 fallback here.
